subject: Robust standard errors and standardized residuals

messages.author: 4a452058453b3a6f
messages.subject: Robust standard errors and standardized residuals
parts:
Hi all,

I am doing some CFA's, with data that has missing data. I am also correcting for non-normality (using the FIML approach).
However, I was wondering, when using robust standard errors can I still have a look at the standardized residuals, to assess the goodness of fit of the model?

Here is my code:

> dataLara <- read.csv(file="data", head=TRUE, sep=";", na.strings="9")
> 
> modelb <- ' ALSAL =~ ALSAL1 + ALSAL2 + ALSAL3 + ALSAL4 
     ALRTL =~ ALRTL1 + ALRTL2 + ALRTL3 + ALRTL4 
     ALMPL =~ ALMPL1 + ALMPL2 + ALMPL3 + ALMPL4 
     ALBPL =~ ALBPL1 + ALBPL2 + ALBPL3 + ALBPL4 
     ALL =~ ALSAL + ALRTL + ALMPL + ALBPL
 	'
> fitb <- sem(model = modelb, data=dataLara, estimator = "MLR", missing="ml", meanstructure = TRUE)
> resid(fitb, type ="standardized")

error after last line:

Error in compute.A1.sample(samplestats = object@SampleStats, group = g,  : 
  unused argument(s) (samplestats = object@SampleStats)


Many thanks in advance

Anneleen
